card.name: Just before a cancer or tumor word
card.fires_on: Small words or word parts right before an expected cancer, tumor or carcinoma term. The next word is usually cancer-related, such as 'cancer', 'tumor' or 'carcinogenesis'.

modes.label: Linking word before cancer
modes.description: A small linking word like 'for', 'on' or 'and' sits where a cancer term is expected next.
modes.example: chronic respiratory disease<< and>> cancer, are the leading causes of death

modes.label: Inside cancer words
modes.description: A partial piece of a cancer word, such as 'ant', 'CAR' or 'C', comes just before the rest of the word.
modes.example: may interfere with the<< ant>>itumor activity of the chemotherapy regimen.

modes.label: Hotline number spelled as CANCER
modes.description: The phone number 1-800-4-CANCER is split into pieces, with the marked piece just before the rest of the word.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write cancer, tumor and oncology words next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be cancer or tumor.
